programme.title: Le principal Franklin
programme.desc: Après que le Principal Franklin se soit fait renvoyer accidentellement à cause de Carly, Sam et Freddie, Mme Briggs et Mr Howard prennent le contrôle de l'école et instaurent des règles sévères ainsi qu'un code vestimentaire.

programme.title: Le bal des Demoiselles
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie organisent un speed dating afin de choisir celui qui accompagnera Carly à un bal. Pendant ce temps, Spencer suit un curieux régime.

programme.title: La Pop Star
programme.desc: Carly et ses amis tentent d'aider une ancienne pop star à réaliser la vidéo de son grand retour.

programme.title: Freddy, mon héros
programme.desc: Freddy sauve Carly qui était sur le point de se faire percuter par un camion. Elle tombe alors amoureuse de lui.

programme.title: La séparation
programme.desc: Une dispute remet en question l'amitié entre Carly et Sam. Est-ce là la fin d'iCarly?

programme.title: La séparation
programme.desc: Une dispute remet en question l'amitié entre Carly et Sam. Est-ce là la fin d'iCarly?

programme.title: Gibby perd son sang froid
programme.desc: Gibby est persuadé que Freddie est intéressé par sa nouvelle petite amie. Il lui propose alors de le défier au cours d'un combat, que Sam décide de diffuser en direct dans l'émission de Carly.

programme.title: LAmour perdu de Lewbert
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie découvrent que Lewbert avait une petite amie et qu'il était heureux. Ils décident de retrouver Marta en espérant qu'elle lui apportera à nouveau le bonheur. Mais la vie n'est pas toujours comme on l'imagine...

programme.title: Le concours de beauté
programme.desc: Sam révèle à Carly et Freddie avoir participé à un concours de beauté lorsqu'elle était plus jeune.

programme.title: Le rendez-vous de Spencer
programme.desc: Sam se retrouve accidentellement en prison et Carly et Freddie font leur possible pour que l'émission ait lieu malgré tout. Ils demandent alors l'aide de Spencer, qui a malheureusement un rendez-vous ce soir là.

programme.title: dans lespace
programme.desc: iCarly se voit proposer de tourner un web show exceptionnel dans l'Espace grâce à un milliardaire qui souhaite promouvoir un nouveau concept de voyage spatial...

programme.title: Bigfoot
programme.desc: A la suite d'un reportage aux infos, Carly est bien décidée à prouver à tout le monde que BIGFOOT, un primate humanoïde, existe réellement.

programme.title: Freddie déménage!
programme.desc: Freddie ne supporte plus que ça mère le traite comme un bébé et déménage. Carly et Sam monte une affaire de photographie animalière, mais sont vite dérangées par d'autres photographes ne supportant pas la concurrence.

programme.title: Vague de chaleur
programme.desc: A cause de la vague de chaleur, la ville subit une panne de courant. Spencer, toujours plein da ressource, met en marche un générateur électrique et un climatiseur ultra performant.

programme.title: La psychopathe
programme.desc: L'équipe d'iCarly doit se rendre au Webicône à Olympia, un festival qui réunit toutes les plus grandes stars du Web... Avant de partir, ils reçoivent un mail vidéo de Nora, une jeune fan désespérée et sans ami.

programme.title: La psychopathe
programme.desc: L'équipe d'iCarly doit se rendre au Webicône à Olympia, un festival qui réunit toutes les plus grandes stars du Web... Avant de partir, ils reçoivent un mail vidéo de Nora, une jeune fan désespérée et sans ami.

programme.title: Battle Drone
programme.desc: 6 mercenaires sont engagés par la CIA pour enlever l'héritier d'une république et éliminer un marchand d'armes à Moscou et reçoivent une autre mission à Tchernobyl où la trahison les attend.

programme.title: Mousquetaires pour toujours
programme.desc: Un groupe d'anciens agents secrets ouvre un club de jazz à Las Vegas. Lorsqu'ils découvrent qu'une réserve indienne locale est menacée par un gangster avide et puissant, ils passent à l'action. Tous pour un - et un pour tous !

programme.title: La Prison
programme.desc: UN ANCIEN POLICIER CONDAMNÉ REJOINT UN SYNDICAT DU CRIME SECRET AU SEIN DE LA PRISONYu-gon (KIM Rae-won), ancien inspecteur de police tourmenté, est incarcéré pour un délit de fuite. En prison, il découvre que tout l'établissement est contrôlé par un détenu nommé Ik-ho (HAN Seok-kyu), qui dirige un syndicat du crime avec l'aide du directeur et des gardiens, leur fournissant ainsi l'alibi parfait. Rapidement, Yu-gon devient un membre clé de l'empire criminel d'Ik-ho.

programme.title: Bloodmoney
programme.desc: Un cartel de la drogue colombien s'associe à un groupe de triades de Hong Kong et au tueur à gages le plus chaud de la planète, pour expédier deux tonnes de cocaïne en Australie et en Chine.

programme.title: Un Noël en Alaska
programme.desc: Lorsque la femme d'affaires Jennifer apprend que ses parents seront absents pendant les vacances de fin d'année, elle décide de quitter sa vie animée de citadine à San Francisco, pour visiter l'auberge de sa grand-mère en Alaska dont elle a héritée.

programme.title: Un refuge pour mon bébé
programme.desc: Dans une violente tempête de neige, cinq jours avant Noël, deux jeunes se rencontrent par hasard : Lisa, 23 ans, enceinte et effrayée, et Brad, snowboardeur professionnel.

programme.title: Je ne suis pas prête pour Noël
programme.desc: La vie agitée de Holly axée sur sa carrière déraille quand elle découvre qu'elle ne peut plus mentir à cause d'un vœu que sa nièce Anna a fait au père Noël.

programme.title: Une Belle Rencontre Pour Noël
programme.desc: Après avoir vécu une rupture brutale le jour même où elle recevait le prestigieux prix d'une agence de publicité, Kelly, directrice de la création publicitaire, renonce à toute relation amoureuse afin de se concentrer sur une importante campagne de Noël.

programme.title: Un Souhait Pour Noël
programme.desc: Sophie Kelly, avocate talentueuse, est au bord de la crise de nerfs. Son travail, ses trois enfants et son mari lui prennent tout son temps. La rencontre avec un Père Noël dans un centre commercial va changer sa vie…

programme.title: The Survivalist
programme.desc: Après qu'un virus mortel a décimé l'humanité, un ancien agent du FBI protège une jeune femme naturellement immunisée. Traquée par un gang dirigé par un dangereux psychopathe qui veut exploiter son immunité, elle représente peut-être le dernier espoir de sauver le monde.

programme.title: Monster Island
programme.desc: Des vagues de monstres aux proportions démesurées frappent la Terre, toujours plus dangereux que les précédents. Les derniers espoirs de l'humanité reposent sur un scientifique spécialisé dans les créatures mythiques.

programme.title: Diamonds War
programme.desc: Un ancien combattant de MMA et ses frères doivent sauver leur famille kidnappée d'un dangereux syndicat du crime après le vol de 50 millions de dollars de diamants issus de trafics.

programme.title: Immortelle
programme.desc: Une vampire tente de séduire un peintre pour qu'il accepte de faire son portrait afin qu'elle puisse se voir pour la première fois.

programme.title: Denis et les zombies
programme.desc: Mathias emmène ses camarades tourner un film de zombies dans la maison de campagne familiale. Mais les autochtones ne voient pas le tournage d'un très bon œil et Denis, l'ami d'enfance de Mathias, va se révéler de plus en plus collant.

programme.title: Bootyful
programme.desc: Estelle ne s'attendait pas à rencontrer Sacha ce samedi soir. Travesti et libéré, ce dernier va faire voler en éclats ses idées très arrêtées sur la danse, la séduction, l'amour...

programme.title: L'échappée
programme.desc: Alice chante, se maquille et rigole toute seule. Elle est heureuse. Pourtant elle est à l'hôpital, et vient de se faire opérer. Elle est très malade et totalement chauve. Mais elle est amoureuse de son chirurgien. Il l'a sauvée et vient la voir tous les soirs dans sa chambre. Ses visites sont pour Alice un moment magique qui lui permettent d'oublier son insupportable situation. Alice s'échappe dans son imaginaire et se réinvente une vie plus douce et pleine d'amour…

programme.title: Johnno's Dead
programme.desc: Passer 12 ans derrière les barreaux pour un crime que vous n'avez pas commis, ça fait cogiter. Tout devient clair comme l'eau de roche. L'injustice empoisonne l'esprit, et il ne reste plus que de vieux comptes à régler.

programme.title: Brexicuted
programme.desc: Ce film d'animation satirique dépeint les causes du Brexit. Un groupe de personnages anglais, interrogés au lendemain du vote pour la sortie du Royaume-Uni de l'Union européenne, parlent de ce qui a motivé leur décision.

programme.title: Bavure
programme.desc: Au commencement était la tache. Un coup de pinceau fait surgir un être de la gouache, l'ouvre, le transforme, le tord, le complète. De cette évolution en accéléré nait un être conquérant…

programme.title: Expire
programme.desc: Un brouillard toxique, le Smog, a recouvert la planète et oblige les hommes à vivre confinés. Mais quand on a quinze ans, comme Juliette, la vraie vie est dehors.

programme.title: Mur
programme.desc: Un soir d'hiver, par un temps de neige, une femme se rend à son travail. L'environnement est hostile, le labeur éreintant. Une fenêtre ne ferme plus : il neige à l‘intérieur... Le lieu de corvée devient espace de découverte.

programme.title: Ce que cache la neige
programme.desc: Depuis qu'il a découvert l'infidélité de sa femme, Alexandre, 35 ans, rumine sa colère. Une idée l'obsède : tuer sa femme pour lui faire payer sa traîtrise. A bout, il se rend dans les locaux de la Simile, une société qui pourra l'aider à concrétiser son projet…

programme.title: A rebours
programme.desc: Alors que Sylvie est en retard pour ouvrir l'épicerie dans laquelle elle travaille, deux clients font irruption : Frank, un jeune homme au visage grave que Sylvie semble connaître, et Julie, une jeune femme qui a l'air de traverser une bien mauvaise passe. Une dispute éclate rapidement entre eux ...

programme.title: Voiler la face
programme.desc: Amine est un jeune musulman rigoriste, très amoureux de sa femme, Enora, une jeune convertie. Lorsque sa femme reçoit une amie, qui comme elle, porte le voile intégral, Amine quitte systématiquement l'appartement et ne voit jamais le visage de l'invitée. Jusqu'au jour où les remarques de ses amis éveillent sa jalousie. Le doute s'insinue dans l'esprit d'Amine : qui se cache sous la burqa ?

programme.title: Navire
programme.desc: Des lettres d'amour jamais envoyées. Un navire miniature qui n'a jamais vogué. Des papiers roulés dans ses voiles. La mer tout autour qui laisse émerger une voix.

programme.title: Dolça
programme.desc: Dans un village du Sud de la France, Dolça, une jeune lycéenne, babysitte Sam, un enfant de dix ans avec qui elle a une relation très complice, jusqu'à ce qu'elle entame une liaison avec son père cette liaison va bouleverser sa relation avec l'enfant.

programme.title: Les guerriers
programme.desc: Rongé par ses désirs autant que ses frustrations, Thomas, seize ans, peine à se construire. Si bien qu'il lui est bientôt impossible de contenir cette rage sourde qui l'anime. Mais loin de le détruire, la colère est son premier élan vers la liberté.

programme.title: Féroce
programme.desc: Après avoir été kidnappé dans son appartement, un jeune cadre d'entreprise se réveille en pleine forêt. Il se retrouve alors traqué par un mystérieux chasseur.

programme.title: Time Rodent
programme.desc: Dans un futur lointain où la nuit a dévoré le jour, les habitants d'un monde en mutation accélérée se nourrissent exclusivement de lumière artificielle.

programme.title: Metamorphosis
programme.desc: Il est trentenaire et habite encore chez sa mère. Taciturne et tourmenté, il a définitivement perdu contact avec la réalité. Une nuit, il profite de l'absence de sa mère pour se libérer une fois pour toutes de ses démons intérieurs.

programme.title: Trois petits points
programme.desc: Une petite couturière attend son mari parti à la guerre.

programme.title: Rhapsodie pour un pot-au-feu
programme.desc: Trois générations d'une même famille cohabitent sous le même toit dans une chorégraphie désaccordée. La mère, chef d'orchestre de la famille, tente en vain de les réunir à table pour le dîner.

programme.title: Floating in my mind
programme.desc: Un film qui raconte l'histoire de la vie, de rencontres, de souvenirs...

programme.title: Le dernier jour d'un condamné
programme.desc: Camille, une jeune lycéenne, est en pleines révisions. Lassée par son travail, Camille jette un œil dans le frigidaire et y trouve un homard vivant. Se prenant d'affection pour l'animal, l'adolescente décide de lui faire vivre les plus belles heures de son existence...

programme.title: A Shadow of blue
programme.desc: Un soir d'automne, dans un parc situé au milieu d'une ville morne, une petite fille assise sur un banc, nous fait partager plusieurs visions d'une même réalité.

programme.title: Totems
programme.desc: Un bûcheron travaille dans la forêt quand un arbre s'écrase sur lui et l'immobilise. La détresse réveille alors l'animal caché en lui…

programme.title: Pim Poum le petit Panda
programme.desc: Pour Daniel, Pim-Poum le panda c'est presque le rôle de sa vie. Presque, parce que dans le fond ce qui l'intéresse c'est d'être payé. En compagnie de Lucie et Caro, et sous la direction de Marie-Agnès, ils vont se présenter devant leur public : un groupe d'enfants de 5 ans. Alors que la représentation aurait pu bien se dérouler, les interêts de chacun, l'interprétation des personnages et la mise en scène font virer le spectacle au désastre.

programme.title: Le distributeur d'aurores boréales
programme.desc: Lola collectionne les horloges cassées depuis qu'elle a perdu sa mère. Une nuit, elle découvre que l'une d'elle est hantée... Peut-on tomber amoureux d'un fantôme? Que se passerait-il s'il revenait dans la réalité ?

programme.title: Regards libres
programme.desc: Des enfants observent, commentent et critiquent un tableau.

programme.title: Tomatl, chronique de la fin d'un monde
programme.desc: La tomate fut découverte par les européens en même temps que le Nouveau Monde. Les Aztèques léguèrent cette plante, qui couvre aujourd'hui le tiers des surfaces de la planète...

programme.title: Dangerous Intentions
programme.desc: Depuis des années, Beth Williamson supporte le comportement extrêmement violent de son mari Tim. Elle cache la terrible réalité à sa famille ainsi qu'à ses amis, mais surtout à sa fille Laurie. Un jour, elle décide de prendre sa vie en main et retourne chez sa mère. Emprisonné puis relâché, Tim a juré de se venger. Entre temps Beth rencontre Kaye, elle aussi victime de violence conjugale. Les deux amies prennent une maison ensemble en espérant que la vie va enfin commencer pour elles et leurs enfants...

programme.title: Gandahar
programme.desc: Gandahar, paisible oasis au cour d'une galaxie agitée, est menacée par une force terrible et mystérieuse.

programme.title: Cent Jours A Palerme
programme.desc: Au printemps 1982, le général Dalla Chiesa affiche de brillants états de service après avoir réussi à vaincre les Brigades rouges. Alors qu'il pourrait partir à la retraite, satisfait du devoir accompli, et mener une vie paisible aux côtés de sa compagne Emanuela, il accède à un dernier poste. Il accepte la charge de Préfet à Palerme, une ville contrôlée par la Mafia sicilienne. Peu de temps après son arrivée, le député communiste Pio La Torre est éliminé par Cosa Nostra. Révolté par ce crime et la corruption ambiante, Dalla Chiesa sera désormais la bête noire des parrains du crime. Ces derniers sont bien décidés à lui barrer la route. Lino Ventura excelle en justicier sans peur et sans reproches dans ce drame politique inspiré de faits authentiques.

programme.title: Murder in New Hampshire : The Pamela wojas smart story
programme.desc: Une institutrice du New Hampshire séduit l'un de ses élèves pour le convaincre de tuer son mari. "Le crime de Pamela Smart" est une histoire vraie qui a choqué un pays tout entier.

programme.title: Lies before kisses
programme.desc: Une femme découvre que son mari est non seulement le principal suspect dans une affaire de meurtre impliquant une call-girl, mais qu'il fait également l'objet d'un chantage.

programme.title: Ophelia
programme.desc: L'esprit singulier d'Ophélie capture l'affection de Hamlet. Pendant que la luxure et la trahison menacent le royaume, Ophélie se retrouve coincée entre le véritable amour et le contrôle de son propre destin.

programme.title: Salem Games
programme.desc: Un groupe d'adolescents de Salem découvre une lame maudite qui les oblige à jouer à des versions horribles et mortelles des jeux d'enfance. Il n'y a pas de gagnants, seulement des survivants.

programme.title: Le Prix de la Rédemption
programme.desc: Après seize ans de prison pour meurtre, Adam retrouve son quartier avec l'espoir de rencontrer le fils qu'il n'a jamais connu. Mais le frère de sa victime rôde. Mike, lui, veut échapper au trafic de son oncle. Quand leurs destins se croisent, une spirale de violence s'enclenche.

programme.title: Le bal des folles
programme.desc: Au 19e siècle, une femme qui a le don unique d'entendre et de voir les morts est internée dans un asile psychiatrique, sans possibilité de s'échapper.

programme.title: Mon amour, mon obsession
programme.desc: Après le meurtre de son fiancé, Megan refait sa vie. Mais Lloyd, son ex-collègue obsédé, est prêt à tout.

programme.title: Dans l'enfer de la captivité
programme.desc: Mai 1977, Janice et Cameron prennent une auto-stoppeuse nommée Colleen dans leur voiture et la kidnappent,

programme.title: Où est l'argent
programme.desc: Un jeune homme vif d'esprit des rues de South Central doit intégrer en urgence une fraternité blanche comme neige de l'Université du Sud de la Californie pour récupérer un stock d'argent volé.

programme.title: Tout ou rien
programme.desc: Un homme d'affaire veuf et en difficulté et son meilleur ami, lui aussi veuf, remplissent des papiers pour déclarer qu'ils sont un couple gay afin de tirer profit d'une brèche dans le système financier.

programme.title: Le meilleur cuisinier
programme.desc: Melissa McCarthy partage l'affiche avec une troupe de génies de la comédie et un mocumentaire délicieusement espiègle sur le monde passionné et cruel de la compétition culinaire.

programme.title: Le meilleur cuisinier
programme.desc: Melissa McCarthy partage l'affiche avec une troupe de génies de la comédie et un mocumentaire délicieusement espiègle sur le monde passionné et cruel de la compétition culinaire.

programme.title: Où est l'argent
programme.desc: Un jeune homme vif d'esprit des rues de South Central doit intégrer en urgence une fraternité blanche comme neige de l'Université du Sud de la Californie pour récupérer un stock d'argent volé.

programme.title: LE 2E AMENDEMENT
programme.desc: Le Major Vic Davis, est en route pour aller chercher son fils, Shawn, à l'université. A peine arrivé, il se retrouve au milieu d'une opération terroriste de grande envergure visant la fille d'un juge de la Cour suprême.

programme.title: Man About Town
programme.desc: Au sommet du succès, un agent hollywoodien découvre que sa femme le trompe et que son journal intime a été dérobé par un journaliste…

programme.title: Jeff, Who Lives at Home
programme.desc: Lorsqu'il se fait expulser de chez sa mère, Jeff pense pouvoir enfin découvrir son destin en passant la journée avec son frère à la recherche de sa femme qui semble être infidèle.

programme.title: A.I. Artificial Intelligence
programme.desc: Dans le futur, les humains vivent aux côtés de robots de compagnie, les Mechas. Mais lorsque David, un prototype d'enfant robot, est programmé pour donner un amour inconditionnel, sa famille humaine n'est pas prête à en subir les conséquences.

programme.title: Duels
programme.desc: Un ancien braqueur de banques devenu shérif n'a plus aucun souvenir de son ancienne vie.

programme.title: Ne serait-ce que
programme.desc: Une tragédie apprend au jeune homme d'affaires anglais Ian Wyndham à faire passer l'amour avant le travail. Il apprend enfin à s'ouvrir à sa petite amie Samantha Andrews.

programme.title: Apartment 12
programme.desc: Un artiste de Los Angeles voit sa vie basculer lorsque son exposition d'art est annulée et que sa petite-amie mannequin le quitte.

programme.title: Parle tout bas si c'est d'amour
programme.desc: Une prof de SVT, une grand-mère, des parents en colère et un proviseur : Caroline et Olivier, seize ans, aimeraient que leurs parents et l'Education Nationale cessent de leur parler d'amour. Ils s'aiment, mais ils ont peur de ne pas être à la hauteur. Leur première fois, ils la veulent belle.

programme.title: On sera 2!
programme.desc: Afin de survivre à la fièvre des mariages de l'été, les vieux amis célibataires Ben et Alice, décident de devenir l'accompagnant de l'autre à chaque fois que l'un d'entre eux sera invité.

programme.title: Allumeuses!
programme.desc: Trois amies croquent la vie à pleines dents et n'ont pas besoin d'hommes pour être heureuses. Jusqu'au jour où l'une d'entre elles tombe amoureuse... Christina s'est toujours efforcée de respecter une règle d'or en matière de mecs: "Eviter toute relation sérieuse avec le sexe opposé".

programme.title: Une Pluie sans Fin
programme.desc: Un homme licencié d'une aciérie veut désespérément traquer un tueur en série dans une petite ville du sud de la Chine.

programme.title: Coup de foudre en Toscane
programme.desc: Un jeune écrivain ambitieux (Jackson) retrouve un titan de la littérature (Keitel) souffrant du syndrome de la page blanche dans son refuge en Italie rurale, et apprend la vie et l'amour auprès de ce génie irascible et de ses filles.

programme.title: Golem, le Tueur de Londres
programme.desc: Le Londres victorien est terrorisé par un tueur en série inconnu qui laisse des messages énigmatiques écrits avec le sang de ses victimes. Lorsque les meurtres se multiplient, Scotland Yard confie l'affaire à un inspecteur célèbre.

programme.title: Le Quatrième Pouvoir
programme.desc: Un journaliste se retrouve impliqué dans un complot terroriste à Moscou alors qu'il enquête sur les services secrets russes.

programme.title: Par Amour
programme.desc: Dans un cours de théâtre, l'amour sera vécu aussi fort que l'histoire de la pièce de Shakespeare.

programme.title: Ice
programme.desc: la Russie contemporaine. Nadya abandonne son rêve lorsqu'elle est hospitalisée pour une blessure.

programme.title: Un hologramme pour le roi
programme.desc: Un homme accepte le job de sa vie dans le but de vendre une technologie d'hologramme à un monarque.

programme.title: Le Voyage Fantastique: Des Freres Bodganov
programme.desc: Une série innovante qui éclaire des sujets captivants.

programme.title: Au Cœur des Sentiments
programme.desc: Deux sœurs se retrouvent dans la maison familiale et retrouvent espoir après la mort de leur père.

programme.title: L'amour dans l'oreillette
programme.desc: Sam, coach en amour réputée à Los Angeles, guide ses clients pendant leurs rendez-vous. Mais lorsque Mattie remet en cause ses méthodes, Sam découvre que le véritable amour ne suit peut-être aucune règle.

programme.title: Ce qu'on fait par amour
programme.desc: Sophie, médiatrice ambitieuse, rejoint une prestigieuse firme de bien-être à Manhattan. Obligée de collaborer avec Jason, séduisant coach de vie et fils du patron, elle découvre que leurs opposés s'attirent.

programme.title: Saisis ta chance à Noël
programme.desc: Sutton, mère célibataire, doit passer les fêtes de fin d'année à trouver de nouveaux clients pour sa maison d'édition. Son fils, Jae, profite de sa magie de Noël pour lui montrer qu'elle peut trouver quelqu'un qui saura combler son cœur et lui décrocher un livre qui changera sa carrière.

programme.title: Et Satan conduit le bal
programme.desc: Dans une villa provençale, trois couples se livrent à un dangereux jeu de séduction où désir, manipulation et jalousie mènent peu à peu au drame.

programme.title: L'Édition de l'Amour
programme.desc: Pour rendre jaloux son ex-fiancé, une rédactrice beauté demande à un photographe de jouer son petit ami. Mais à force de jouer la comédie, leurs sentiments deviennent de plus en plus réels.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?
programme.desc: Nick rêve d'un rendez-vous avec Suzanne, mais elle ne souhaite que son amitié. Lorsqu'elle se trouve coincée à cause de son travail, il lui propose de lui amener ses enfants à Vancouver pour le réveillon. Mais pour eux, aucun homme n'est assez bien pour leur mère, et ils sont capables de tout.

programme.title: Un Ange Gardien Pour Tess
programme.desc: Doug, un agent des services secrets américains, est soulagé : il vient enfin de terminer sa mission au service de Tess Carlisle, la femme du précédent président des Etats-Unis.

programme.title: Bad Teacher (2011)
programme.desc: Après avoir été plaquée par son fiancé, une jeune enseignante de collège vulgaire se met en tête de séduire un de ses collègues. Mais la jeune femme est confrontée à une rivale de taille, très appréciée des autres.

programme.title: Chef
programme.desc: Carl Casper, Chef cuisinier, préfère démissionner soudainement de son poste plutôt que d'accepter de compromettre son intégrité créative par les décisions du propriétaire de l'établissement. Il doit alors décider de son avenir. Se retrouvant ainsi à Miami, il s'associe à son ex-femme, son ami et son fils pour lancer un food truck. Lors de son ultime mission, les choses tournent mal et le fils de Howard Saint, puissant businessman et magnat de la pègre, est tué. Ivre de vengeance, Saint organise le massacre de Frank et de toute sa famille.

programme.title: Tigre Et Dragon
programme.desc: Élu "Meilleur Film de l'année" par plus de 100 critiques américains ! Deux maîtres guerriers (Chow Yun Fat et Michelle Yeoh) affrontent leur plus grande épreuve suite au vol de l'épée de la Destinée. Une jeune aristocrate (Zhang Ziyi) se prépare à un mariage arrangé et révèle ses incroyables talents de combat et son passé romantique. Bien que tous les guerriers luttent pour la justice, ils affrontent leurs pires ennemis et le pouvoir inévitable et puissant de l'amour. Avec des paysages somptueux de la Chine du 19ème siècle, CROUCHING TIGER, HIDDEN DRAGON est un blockbuster plein d'action du réalisateur acclamé Ang Lee (Sense and Sensibility, The Ice Storm) qui offre d'impressionnantes chorégraphies d'arts martiaux de Yuen Wo Ping (Matrix).

programme.title: Lake Placid : Héritage

Ils y découvrent une île dans laquelle se trouve un laboratoire abandonné, mais s'aperçoivent qu'elle abrite quelque chose de terrifiant : un prédateur des plus mortel. Avant même qu'ils n'aient temps de faire demi-tour, nos aventuriers sont pris au piège. Ils vont rapidement devoir mettre leur rivalité de côté pour réagir ensemble, s'ils veulent avoir la moindre chance de rester en vie…

programme.title: Lake Placid: The Final Chapter

Après leur dernière attaque mortelle, le gouvernement les a envoyé dans une réserve protégée … où ils ont atteint une taille record, attendant leur dernière chance de dévorer de la chair humaine. Et lorsque une équipe de natation se retrouve prise au piège sur leur territoire… le dîner est servi ! Retrouvez Yancy Butler (surivivante de Lake Placid 3) et Robert Englund (le mythique interprète de Freddy Krueger) dans le dernier chapitre de la saga la plus mordante du cinéma d'horreur !

programme.title: Julian Clary On Easing Anxiety
programme.desc: Can laughter ease anxiety? Comedian Julian Clary certainly thinks so. After living some incredibly dark events and anxious times, he's decided to choose to laugh and think positive thoughts. In this chat with Fearne, Julian talks about feeling naturally happier and more comfortable in his skin as he got older. Most things, he says, just aren't as important as you think they are, and that's a freeing realisation.

programme.title: Louise Redknapp On Coping With Loneliness And Low Self-Esteem
programme.desc: Singer Louise Redknapp discusses feeling pressure to be the 'good girl' after years in a 90s girlband and marriage to a sports star, which left her afraid of saying or doing the wrong thing. She explores how not knowing her dad and becoming a mother have impacted her confidence and identity, and shares how she's learning to trust her own gut instinct and embrace different facets of her character.

programme.title: Kate Winslet: Why I'm Embracing Wrinkles And Championing Women
programme.desc: Grief can make you feel unnervingly vulnerable this is how Kate Winslet reflects on losing her mum in 2017. In this chat, Fearne and Kate share their own experiences of both grieving and co-parenting at Christmas. Regularly labelled as "fat" by the media, Kate explains what effect that scrutiny had on her self-esteem, and why it's made her even more passionate about setting an example to younger women by ageing naturally.

programme.title: Jesy Nelson On Finding Herself And Feeling Free After Leaving Little Mix
programme.desc: As part of Little Mix, Jesy Nelson felt constantly compared to her bandmates and struggled with the pressure of being in a girl band, leading to self-esteem problems and depression. She discusses with Fearne how appearance mattered as much as talent in the music industry.

programme.title: Brian Cox On Finding Purpose In A Vast Universe
programme.desc: What can the universe teach us about being human? Physicist Professor Brian Cox discusses getting comfortable with being wrong, the difference between having an argument and making an argument, and how curiosity and doubt are essential to learning and happiness. He explores why ego blocks human progress, how democracy depends on doubt, the beauty of curiosity, the randomness of life, and our greatest moral responsibility in protecting the planet.

programme.title: Leah Williamson On Bouncing Back From A Footballer's Worst Nightmare
programme.desc: Footballer Leah Williamson discusses how getting through a major injury has made her love the person she is now more than the one she was before because of the way she looks after herself. Leah talks about the importance of listening to your own body, and trusting what it's trying to tell you rather than ignoring or overriding it.

programme.title: How Coleen And Wayne Rooney Make Their Marriage Work
programme.desc: Coleen Rooney discusses how she and husband Wayne prioritise honesty, family and their relationship after many years together. She explains how she's instilling honesty in her four sons and the importance of having a village to help raise her boys. Coleen also discusses school gate WhatsApp group dynamics, dealing with stress, and what it was like being thrust into the public eye as a teenager when her boyfriend became a footballer.

programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

Cheong Ja decides to return to acting, hoping to restore her former glory and figure out what happened to her. She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

programme.title: Extinction! Going, Going, Gone
programme.desc: Extinction, a daunting and confusing word. A force of nature, that sees the end of species, but also heralds the birth of others. programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.desc: Secluded for many centuries in inaccessible valleys, the inhabitants of the Alps had no alternative but to rely on the healing powers of nature. A knowledge of herbs was deeply rooted in these mountain-dwellers' everyday lives – until the twentieth century, when this wisdom became eclipsed by modern academic medicine. Today, Alpine herbs are witnessing a revival, as public interest in regional natural treasures grows. The potential of Alpine herbs is far from exhausted. In the Berchtesgaden Alps, the film shows Hubsi Ilsanker at work as a root-digger, a back-breaking job that has scarcely changed in four hundred years. Authorized by a special historic permit to supply the oldest gentian distillery in Germany, Hubsi digs for protected gentian roots in Berchtesgaden National Park. For yellow gentian is one of the most bitter medicinal herbs in the world, well suited for schnapps and as a general tonic.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.desc: In the pristine nature and mild climate of southeastern Europe grows a unique diversity of wild plants. Far removed from major industry and polluted soils, the Balkan countries have become the largest exporter of herbs in Europe. In Bulgaria alone, more than 300,000 people work with domestic plants. The business is becoming increasingly lucrative. The film takes us to the Croatian coast. On the Adriatic island of Cres, the audience meets Mladen Dragoslavić. In May, when the sage begins to blossom, this beekeeper has one month to produce his income for an entire year – always with the goal of creating the best sage honey in the Balkans. Given a choice, the bees would never choose sage, for entering and exiting the narrow blossom is strenuous. Within three weeks, maximum, Mladen must remove his bees from the island. Otherwise they will die of exhaustion. In Skopje, the capital of Macedonia, the film visits Iva Yosifova. Hollyhock provides the raw material for her objects of art. The herb is medically beneficial, due to its mucilage, which is added to many cough tea mixtures. Iva, though, makes paper from hollyhock. Thanks to the herb's long fibres, the paper can be spread onto objects and modeled. The technique produces delicate sculptures, as fragile as nature.

programme.title: Stories of the Mediterranean Forest: Sierra Morena
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Basin is one of the planet's most biologically rich and complex regions. The crossroads of Europe, Asia and Africa is considered to be one of Earth's biodiversity hotspots. A vast number of both animal and plant species unique to the region live in its various habitats. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet's temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: Fertile Floods
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Europe's Wild River
programme.sub-title: The Elbe - 1.000 Miles of Wildlife and Nature
programme.desc: The river rises in the Czech Giant Mountains. Here it is called the Labe. After Děčín it flows into Germany and is called Elbe. There are various explanations for the origin of the river name "Elbe". One often mentioned is the Latin name of the river "albia", which means "bright water". This would also explain why the stream is referred to with the feminine article "the Elbe", since the Latin term "albia" is also feminine. Rather poetic than linguistically probable, however, is the explanation that elves (Middle High German: alb) scurrying around the pines in the white river mists could have helped the river to get its name. Geographically, the river can be divided into different sections: The Upper Elbe is the part from the source to about Riesa in the administrative district of Dresden, which is more characterized by mountains. The Middle Elbe, on the other hand, is a lowland river. It reaches as far as the Geesthacht dam just outside Hamburg. The Lower Elbe is called the tidal part of the river. Here, the Elbe forms an estuary, a so-called estuary. At high tide, seawater enters this funnel-shaped delta at the mouth of the Elbe and mixes with the freshwater of the river. At low tide, the water then flows off to the North Sea. Finally, the continuation of the estuary funnel in the Wadden Sea is called the Outer Elbe.

Strawberry suggests they hold a big dog show! Plum makes over-ambitious plans to display talents that her dog does not quite have, trying to teach him complicated dance routines.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The Baby Berrykins are enthralled by a fairytale that Blueberry reads to them for Story Time. Charmed by their reaction, Strawberry suggests that the girls do a "berrytale play" for the kids, sort of a "Story Time On Stage." Plum volunteers to direct it. She envisions a small, simple production-until she hears about a gigantic production of "Snowberry and the Seven Berrykins" that's a smash hit in Berry Big City.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry and the girls excitedly plan to put on a "Story Time On Stage" musical play for the Berrykin kids: "Berryella and Prince Berry Charming," directed and choreographed by Plum, with musical direction by Cherry. Strawberry will play Berryella, with Lemon and Blueberry as her comically jealous stepsisters, and costume designer Raspberry as her Fairy Fashionmother.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry and Huck turn the Baby Berrykins' favorite fairy tale, "The Littlest Berrykin," into a comedy play. They pitch it to director Plum and the assembled cast and crew using a large storybook. As Huck and Blueberry narrate the story, we push in on the book and its illustrations transition into animation. In the story, the King and Queen of the Berry Patch (played by Huck and Blueberry) are retiring to the tropics.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Orange wants to spend the day teaching her puppy to fetch, but the frisky little gal doesn't seem to understand the "retrieve" part of the activity-as soon as she gets the ball, she runs out of sight and returns moments later without it. Orange gets a new ball and tries again, with the same results. Over and over, until Orange is out of balls. Puzzled and frustrated that she can't find where her pup has stashed them, she goes to enlist her friends to help her search.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is being driven to distraction! She can't finish a song that she promised to write for a singing group, thanks to the earsplitting noise from Berrykin construction crews who are trying to find the sparkleberry juice blockage that has shut down the town's power. Strawberry can't cook in the café, Lemon's hair salon appliances are running out of control-life in Berry Bitty City is impossible!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With the power completely out in Berry Bitty City, the girls go on a camping trip to be out of the way of the Berrykin work crews. Lemon is nervous because she believes there is a creepy creature in the forest (that she read about in a book Blueberry loaned her), and the girls get the nervous bug, but Strawberry turns their apprehension into fun by daring her friends to stay out in the woods the longest!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls are driven to distraction by their frisky puppies frolicking all over Berry Bitty City! Full of energy and thinking that everything in town is a toy for them to play with, they cause comical mayhem wherever they go. Strawberry suggests the pups need a place of their own where they can play, a dog park! The girls decide to call in Huckleberry, who runs an animal hotel in Berry Big City, to help design the park.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls plan a formal afternoon lawn party tea to inaugurate their new dog park. Plum is in charge of decorations, Cherry music, and Strawberry snacks. There's even a giant, dog-shaped ice sculpture. As the girls get dressed, Raspberry puts the finishing touches on the high-fashion hats that will accompany their beautiful gowns. At last everything is ready. But when the gate opens... the puppies back away!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: To convince the dance-averse Huckleberry to attend the big masquerade ball at the dog park, Blueberry promises she'll stay by his side the whole evening and make sure he doesn't have to dance. But as the day of the ball dawns, Blueberry awakens with a bad cold. She doesn't know how to tell Huck that she can't go to the ball. Lemon and Raspberry misinterpret her sniffles, thinking she's so heartbroken to be disappointing Huck that she's crying!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Berry Biggest, Berry Baddest Bakeoff
programme.desc: Berry Bitty City is abuzz as Berrykin Bloom introduces the biggest, juiciest, strangest fruit anyone has ever seen! It's the size of a house, shaped like a strawberry, colored like a watermelon and has a spiky pineapple top. "I call it the sparklestrawwaterpineberry!" says Berrykin Bloom. Princess Berrykin declares it the greatest achievement in Berryculture she's ever witnessed.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks

programme.title: Stiix and Stones
programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword. Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely. The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: Horrifying Story Of Grandmother And Grandson
programme.desc: It happens that grown-up people have their own fears! For example, one grandmother was very afraid not to please her grandson. Whatever she cooked- nothing was good enough for him. Once she tried to give him a tomato, but he just threw it towards the wall! Grandma was very upset and left the house. And so he was left alone and scared- there was no one home! Much fear he had suffered until his grandmother came back! This terrible trick taught him a worthy lesson so nevertheless he was cranky ever after and ate with a terrible appetite!

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: A Ghost Bike Saga Which Makes You Shiver
programme.desc: You think no one could ever be afraid of a bike...Today, you will hear an incredible... and amazing heartbreaking story... about a bicycle! There was one boy called Gosha, who was very upset when he got bicycle for his birthday as he once imagined himself rushing down the street riding that huge two-wheeled scary monster! But in reality it's so simple to ride a bike without any worries...isn't it?

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Are you sure that you really like spooky stories? What if this kind of story will get you really thrilled? Listen to one classic story and don't say that you are not shocked after all!

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: Super Scary Story Of A Little Boy Who Was Afraid Of Washing
programme.desc: One boy was so afraid of the water that he stopped washing himself and turned into a piggy! All his buddies ran away from him scared! But in the end he overcame his fear and began to wash his face and hands as he realized that the water can be safe and fun! The boy was very brave and even won a swimming competition!

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: Horrible True Story Of How A Boy Was Transferred To Another School
programme.desc: Today you will hear a story which you haven't heard before…about one boy who was transferred to another school! He was terrified so much because he thought that another strange school is full of monster-looking teachers, gym classes where you have to fight without rules and classmates-bullies! But in reality there was nothing to be afraid of because all the schools are practically the same- with normal classmates and teachers who are always ready to make you feel comfortable!

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Here is another spooky story about useful inventions that might nonetheless ruin your life…just imagine…what if there is mega brain who wants to conquer the Earth with some mechanical monsters?! You might think it's a joke, but there are so many gadgets around you, can you guarantee that you are safe? Ok, ok, relax, Masha will find a way out! Oh, yeah!

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: Soul Freezing Tale Of Grim Forest And Tiny Timid Bug
programme.desc: All children are afraid of the dark. Masha was afraid of it too and had to sit with a torch all night long! But once upon a time she came up with the tale about a tiny bug, which lived in the woods and was so afraid of the dark, that every rustle made its heart tremble! The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: Gloomy Story About The Darkest Dreams
programme.desc: All children are keen on computer games! Everyone likes to shoot a couple of monsters before going to sleep. Tolik also liked to play shooters until the monsters attack him in reality in order to commit the revenge! Or…was it just a dream? Let's see...

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: The Nutcracker Sweet
programme.desc: It is Christmas Eve and the Silberhaus children are excited for the festivities to begin. Marie and Fritz are playing in the children's room when their godfather Drosselmayer arrives and presents them with an early Christmas gift, a Nutcracker. Marie witnesses a great battle between a vast army of toy soldiers led by the Nutcracker against a terrible platoon of mice commanded by the Mouse King. Follow Marie and Fritz's journey in the Kingdom of Dolls, through the Christmas Forest, past the Almond Milk Sea, and the Palace of the Marzipans.

programme.title: Last Days in the Desert
programme.desc: As Jesus begins his journey out of the wilderness following forty days of fasting and praying, he struggles with the Devil over the fate of a family in crisis. This powerful drama depicting an imagined chapter from Jesus' life stars Golden Globe winner Ewan McGregor (Trainspotting, Star Wars franchise), Academy Award nominee Ciarn Hinds (Belfast, Game of Thrones), and Tye Sheridan (Mud, X-Men franchise).

programme.title: The Captor
programme.desc: Starring Ethan Hawke and Noomi Rapace and from the executive producer of BlacKkKlansman, this thrilling crime caper is based on the absurd but true story of the 1973 Stockholm bank heist. Outlaw Lars takes two workers hostage and demands his friend is released from prison, $1 million and a getaway car. As negotiations reach deadlock, hostage Bianca becomes strangely attracted to her captor.

programme.title: Above the Law
programme.desc: Based on the shocking true story of the unsolved murders of Brabant. When Frank carries out a daring robbery, a commando force kills an examining magistrate investigating a political case. Wrongly charged for the murder, Frank has the challenging task of proving his innocence. This fast-paced, hard-boiled Belgian crime thriller written by notorious former gangster Franois Troukens is a must see!

programme.title: Boudica
programme.desc: This historical action is the bold, bloody story of the Celtic Queen. King Prasutagus rules over the Iceni people with his wife Boudica by his side, but when he is betrayed and killed, Boudica's kingdom is left without a male heir and the Romans seize her land. Determined to avenge her husband's death, Boudica rallies the tribes from the region and wages an epic war against the Roman Empire.

programme.title: The Joker
programme.desc: In this creepy and twisted thriller, a young detective is caught in a horrifically sadistic game of cat-and-mouse when he is kidnapped and tormented by a masked, sex-crazed, serial killer. With a deadly race against time, he only has one method to save himself and a young girl. Starring Ron Perlman (Hellboy) and Halston Sage (Bad Neighbours) this clever, nail-biting nightmare is not to be missed!

programme.title: Escape Room
programme.desc: A mind-bending psychological thriller about a group of friends who find themselves in a sadistic, living nightmare. Six adventurous strangers travel to a mysterious building to experience a game where players compete to solve puzzles to win money. But what starts out as innocent fun soon turns into a suffocating and terrifying game of hell.

programme.title: Rules Don't Apply
programme.desc: An aspiring young actress and her ambitious young driver struggle hopefully with the absurd eccentricities of the wildly unpredictable billionaire Howard Hughes, for whom they work.

programme.title: True Story

programme.title: The Railway Man
programme.desc: Eric Lomax was one of thousands of Allied prisoners of war forced to work on the construction of the Thai/Burma railway during WW2. Years later, he met Patti and fell in love. Discovering that the young Japanese officer who haunted her husband was still alive, she faced a terrible decision.

programme.title: The Tender Bar
programme.desc: ​​From director George Clooney and based on the best-selling memoir, The Tender Bar follows an aspiring writer (Tye Sheridan) pursuing his romantic and professional dreams. From a stool in his uncle's (Ben Affleck) bar, he learns what it means to grow up from a colorful group of local characters.

programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Kim Jae-hyung! Kim Jae-hyung is a self-taught guitarist who picked up the guitar when he was serving in the NAVY as a secretary for the naval military band. He continued playing the instrument after his discharge and had the first public performance in 2013 at an unplugged open mic night. Then in 2017 he released his first EP CIRCUS. Three years later he presented his first full-length album Flex which was nominated for Best Folk Album at the 2021 Korean Music Awards and the lead single Failure Story was nominated for Best Folk Song. Kim Jae-hyung is also known for covering a wide spectrum of music. Recently he came up with a new single titled Addiction with danceable vibes. Constantly pushing his musical boundaries this artist definitely makes us look forward to his future moves. In this episode Kim Jae-hyung performs Addiction Failure Story More Doubt and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is a singer who just wants to present good music - J_ust! J_ust made his debut in 2015 with the mini-album #DearMuse #201507_08 #PinkRibbon. Known for his heartfelt lyrics and sounds he comforts numerous listeners at the end of a tough day. Thanks to that magical power Jeong Eun-ji from Apink released a remake of his song How's your night for the soundtrack of She's My Type and his song Way Back Home was featured in the ending of JTBC Newsroom. In this episode J_ust performs How's your night Way Back Home I wanna go out Actually I like you and will be happy to console everyone's heart. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy all the heartwarming songs he has to comfort you!

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.
